title: hieracium pendulum
intro: Hieracium pendulum, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious or lesser scabious, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include relieving inflammation, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pendulum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects. Further research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
